<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary adjournment:</strong> Both Houses of Parliament have been adjourned sine die following a session marked by intense confrontations between the NDA and the INDIA bloc over issues including Jharkhand protests and Ram temple donations.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxNM254NWtXUTM4a0lreXRqSGN6VXhJbTdNRmRMWENtWlpKc19TVld4Q1B4UDB2X2hmU20ydS1sc2ZXZTFuNkRJcy05Z3RpdXJGUXZuWGFyUDhUQll4WkhTckFoT1pfd2NYVTNZRjNjbjQ5WWdQVDNNUW5fZ2YyNks3SktCajBpZUU2OFdmTE9wSE9nMmZtZFoxZDdB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I16</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQVU9EeEl6X2FSSWU1UFdMYTBSeWI1TVNtM2t5UHNTZDUzb3dWb2VKYmZzSWhQbGRfUWgtdHRMb01nM0RrRFdHVnppVjU1b203M2pvWWJxNDBxeDBOcGpycXJDM1NVM0d3MWdDeGJUN2JYSHJ6c01ZUWo2cGZRN3BLWjcyS1lyX0d4VjBpa0tpVmpESmpMQ01iNTNLQTRWOUpuajFxZ3d1U2FOWkFNQTVJdGZtTQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPMnhwNW5aMWI3VWNPOTBkczZKQ29pM0hhcW04TFpvLTlNUzRyMUYyVzhCd0dFQUp0LUNLWDF1Yk9XS0dGUVVTSDh3WENndnNHdDJhUDZtbUZSRTR3WDRvVXRMaGVMdVN3dW9iMjljM2dVT3JvbC00QkJzekt5eFZ3Z05zMDdTVkZmU29pZ2ZlbkJRVEVHOU5oam9GSUFycEstalYyVDlMM2lWQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Session productivity:</strong> The Monsoon Session concluded with 11 to 12 bills passed, though the government and opposition remain at odds over low productivity rates—reported as low as 19% in the Lok Sabha—and the lack of debate on legislation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxNM254NWtXUTM4a0lreXRqSGN6VXhJbTdNRmRMWENtWlpKc19TVld4Q1B4UDB2X2hmU20ydS1sc2ZXZTFuNkRJcy05Z3RpdXJGUXZuWGFyUDhUQll4WkhTckFoT1pfd2NYVTNZRjNjbjQ5WWdQVDNNUW5fZ2YyNks3SktCajBpZUU2OFdmTE9wSE9nMmZtZFoxZDdB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition boycott:</strong> Tensions escalated as the INDIA bloc boycotted the Lok Sabha Speaker’s tea party, while Congress leader Rahul Gandhi intensified his rhetoric, labeling the BJP-RSS a &quot;bunch of jokers&quot; and criticizing the Prime Minister&#x27;s foreign policy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I33</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I45</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial expansion:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed a bill to increase the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges from 34 to 38, a move previously approved by the Union Cabinet to address judicial caseloads.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Mining legislation:</strong> Parliament successfully passed the Mines and Minerals Amendment Bill, 2026, amid the broader legislative session disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxPMnhwNW5aMWI3VWNPOTBkczZKQ29pM0hhcW04TFpvLTlNUzRyMUYyVzhCd0dFQUp0LUNLWDF1Yk9XS0dGUVVTSDh3WENndnNHdDJhUDZtbUZSRTR3WDRvVXRMaGVMdVN3dW9iMjljM2dVT3JvbC00QkJzekt5eFZ3Z05zMDdTVkZmU29pZ2ZlbkJRVEVHOU5oam9GSUFycEstalYyVDlMM2lWQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxQOWhCQU1vdVQ2bjl1M1hGMkxwNEllNkVzQ1hSSkRGSVhRMDZrdEpWbkVOZTRHOWRzUGdCMktwNDdWTVI4TFMzZ2VSazZtS0hJVHRVZFBoY1dCeHlHVkREamNzRTJoWmRwRkd0WE5BZ29LemcxRTMzbjdFcUgtdG1rbFdneUx6YlgwMVVWT01PTGRFRk1yZmEtVWNpZEdoVm40WkdVdkotcEEyM09pY3VVNUItMzQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
</ul>
